subgroups.name: smoke_test_single_subject
subgroups.hypothesis: H: the new run_extra_sessions.py pipeline executes end-to-end on a single subject (S02) for EEGNet binary before scaling up.
subgroups.rationale: Command flags --models eegnet --subjects S02 --task binary; first chronological run on 03-24; precedes the multi-subject run 1h later.

subgroups.name: pilot_binary_n5
subgroups.hypothesis: H: adding online Sess03-05 progressively improves within-subject binary decoding for EEGNet and CBraMod on the initial 5 extra-session subjects, replicating Ding et al. observation.
subgroups.rationale: docs/dev_log/experiments/extra_sessions_analysis.md §1+§3 cites this run_tag as the N=5 binary result; only 5 subjects auto-discovered at that time; no --test-strategy flag (defaults to per_session).

subgroups.name: test_strategy_comparison_binary
subgroups.hypothesis: H: different test-set strategies (per_session vs fixed_combined vs fixed_sess02) yield different conclusions about extra-session gains because per_session conflates training-data effects with test-set difficulty drift; fixed test sets should reveal monotonic gains.
subgroups.rationale: docs/dev_log/experiments/extra_sessions_strategy_comparison.md §1 designs this 3-strategy comparison and cites 20260324_2131 (per_session), 20260325_0514 (fixed_combined), 20260325_1208 (fixed_sess02) as the canonical results; the multiple 03-24 23:08 to 03-25 05:14 fixed_combined runs are re-attempts of the same strategy.

subgroups.name: ternary_within_subject_n16
subgroups.hypothesis: H: progressive addition of extra sessions Sess03-05 improves CBraMod within-subject ternary (3-class) decoding on the full N=16 extra-session cohort, generalizing the binary findings to the harder task.
subgroups.rationale: docs/dev_log/experiments/extra_sessions_analysis.md §5 cites 20260325_1934 as the N=16 ternary per_session result feeding into paper analysis; the 19:38 run 4 min later is an immediate restart.

subgroups.name: replot_replication_ternary_full
subgroups.hypothesis: H: re-running ternary per_session N=16 on the full extra-session cohort reproduces 20260325_1934 results after pipeline/data updates.
subgroups.rationale: Command flags --task ternary --no-plot --cache-only with no --subjects filter, 2 minutes apart, after the canonical 03-25 ternary baseline already exists.

subgroups.name: two_subject_debug_binary
subgroups.hypothesis: H: a two-subject (S02, S03) binary run completes successfully -- used to debug the pipeline before launching larger sweeps.
subgroups.rationale: Command flags --subjects S02 S03 --no-plot --cache-only repeated three times within 3 minutes on 03-26 16:46-16:49; tight repetition is the classic signature of debugging.

subgroups.name: transfer_extra_sessions_paper
subgroups.hypothesis: H: initializing per-subject fine-tuning from the cross-subject extra-sessions pretrained checkpoint outperforms both pure within-subject and pure cross-subject extra-sessions paradigms, especially at +Sess05.
subgroups.rationale: docs/dev_log/experiments/extra_sessions_analysis.md §7 cites 20260329_1357 (binary, pretrained=20260326_1409) and 20260329_1503 (ternary, pretrained=20260327_0303) as the canonical transfer-learning extra-sessions results.

subgroups.name: ternary_full_eegnet_cbramod_final
subgroups.hypothesis: H: a final paper-quality run of within-subject extra-sessions ternary for both EEGNet and CBraMod (per_session default, N=16) produces the headline numbers for the ternary extra-sessions section.
subgroups.rationale: Command --models eegnet cbramod --task ternary executed late in timeline (03-31) after all strategy/transfer experiments concluded.
